covered_rules: Hash-bound unchanged benchmark version and six selected V2-C checkpoints
Exact ordered three-seed symmetric forward/nucleotide-RC arithmetic
Unchanged threshold decimal and float64 encodings with inclusive calls
Exact frozen identities, no proxies or approximate identity rescue
Frozen REF/ALT orientation and explicit 2001-bp indel geometry
Scorability separate from scope and all exact eligible identities scored
Observation accounting and deduplicated positive-variant denominators
Context-specific nulls, unresolved identities and out-of-model mechanisms preserved
Complete six-model denominator shared by enhancer, H3 and union recovery
Descriptive recovery rather than unavailable classification metrics
No internal-reference percentiles or significance tests
Continuous region-score and delta summaries prespecified
Explicit experimentally resolved allelic direction and strict H3 interpretation
Exact zero-delta ties retained and conflicting experimental directions disclosed
V1 own coverage, common intersection and paired comparisons kept separate
New sequence coverage not misrepresented as paired V1-to-V2 gain
rs2013701 flagged as previously known rather than blinded validation
Source, cell, assay, mechanism, variant-type and coverage stratification
Pre-prediction annotation-map freeze and one outcome-opening event
Hard no-training, no-retuning, no-recalibration and no-candidate-scoring firewall
Independent validation, append-only registers and final checksum freeze
Honest region-versus-allelic interpretation and stop after requested evaluation

scope: Static prospective-design review against the user authorization plus independent SHA-256/size checks of the five frozen pre-open artifacts and cross-file metadata consistency. No benchmark outcome/label payload opened; no benchmark statistics, model inference, or scientific scripts executed. The initializer reports opaque verification of 217 benchmark payloads and six checkpoints; this validator does not independently reread those payloads. Pre-open negative-access declarations are supported by reviewed script behavior, not independently reconstructed full historical process telemetry.
